Soil features: where the profiles and map units are

Source: R/features.R
soil_features.Rd

Reads the features of a selection from the canonical layer of the Global Soil Data Hub (POST /query/features, always canonical = true), page by page: one row per feature (a WoSIS, WISE or SOTER profile location, a SOTER or SOTWIS map unit), with its geometry. The feature_id is the one of soil_observations() read with the same selection, so features and measurements join by it (merge(features, observations, by = "feature_id")).

Usage

soil_features(
  soil = soil_session(),
  datasets = NULL,
  variables = NULL,
  bbox = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  geometry = "any",
  view = "raw",
  profile_type = NULL,
  components = NULL,
  min_cumulative_percent = NULL,
  with_geometry = c("sf", "text"),
  max_rows = Inf,
  page_size = NULL,
  too_large = c("stop", "export"),
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

datasets

Catalog dataset codes ("wosis_points", "wise_profiles", "soter_profiles", "soter_polygons", "sotwis_polygons", "sotwis_components", "sotwis_estimates", see soil_datasets()); NULL (the API default) selects every dataset, usually above the limit of synchronous reads. API field datasets.

variables

Source codes ("ORGC", "CLAY") or canonical property keys ("organic_carbon"), see soil_variables(); NULL returns every variable. With variables the column set is fixed by the request, so every page has the same columns. API field variables.

bbox

c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in WGS84 degrees (longitude, latitude). API field bbox.

country

Countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 or alpha-3 codes or names, case-insensitive (the API resolves them). API field country.

geometry

"any", "point" (profiles) or "polygon" (map units). API field geometry.

view

"raw" or "revised": with "revised" the features the rules of the revised view exclude (SOTER copy profiles whose original is in the selection, R8) are not returned, and the rules are listed in soil_revised_rules(). API field view.

profile_type

Profiles by the source's own type term: "synthetic" (KENSOTER), "virtual" (Upper Tana), "none" (no type in the source record), all selecting or all excluded with a "!" prefix (c("!synthetic", "!virtual")); NULL keeps every profile. API field profile_type.

components

Components of multi-component map units (SOTWIS, SOTER polygons): NULL (the API default, "representative"), "representative" (largest proportion_percent), "all", or "cumulative" (by decreasing proportion until min_cumulative_percent). API field components.

min_cumulative_percent

Threshold of components = "cumulative", 0 to 100 (required with it, refused without it). API field min_cumulative_percent.

with_geometry

"sf" (the default: an sf object, EPSG:4326; needs the package sf, else a soilhub_dependency_error) or "text" (a data frame with geometry_text, the GeoJSON of each feature: no package needed; sf::st_read() or geojsonsf read it). Client-side: not sent to the API (features always carry their GeoJSON geometry).

max_rows

Maximum number of features to read (Inf: the whole selection). Client-side; caps the API field limit of each page request.

page_size

Features per request; NULL uses the session's, the soilhub.page_size option or the server's max_page_size. Client-side; sets the API field limit of each page request.

too_large

What to do when the API refuses the selection as too large for a synchronous read: "stop" raises soilhub_load_limit_error, whose message names the equivalent soil_export(..., content = "features") call; "export" exports the features of the selection (GeoJSON), waits, downloads, reads them back and returns the same shape, with soil_metadata(x)$via_export the job id. Client-side: not sent to the API.

progress

Report the pages read (messages at verbosity 1 or more). Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A soil_table with soil_layout = "features": an sf object (with_geometry = "sf") or a data frame ("text").

Details

Columns (design 5.5), in the API's order: dataset, provider_code, feature_id, feature_key (the canonical key: the reference to the source record), geometry_kind (POINT, POLYGON, MULTIPOLYGON), source_support; when SOTWIS or SOTER polygons are selected components (a list of data frames, one row per selected soil component of the map unit, in selection order: component_id, component_rank, proportion_percent, is_representative, ..., and source_attributes, the source descriptors of the component as a named list); when soter_profiles is selected profile_markings (list of character: no_horizons_in_source for a profile without horizons in the source); retired_in_release (the release in which the feature left ISRIC, still served); then the geometry: geometry (sf) or geometry_text (GeoJSON text).

The API returns only features with a geometry; a feature served without one gets an empty geometry (sf) or NA ("text") and one warning. soil_metadata(x) adds feature_count, feature_count_by_dataset (when several datasets are selected) and mixed_geometry (points and polygons in the result); total_count is NA (the API does not count features; the summary of the selection does).

Pages. At most max_page_size features per request (1000, see soil_capabilities()); a failure after some pages raises the error with the features already read in e$partial (a soil_table whose metadata has complete = FALSE).

Rights: soil:read. Capabilities: canonical_features; revised_view for view = "revised", profile_type_filter for profile_type, component_selection for components.

See also

soil_observations(), soil_citations()

Other reads: soil_observations()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil <- soil_connect()
f <- soil_features(soil, datasets = "wosis_points", country = "KEN")
plot(sf::st_geometry(f))

# without sf: GeoJSON text
g <- soil_features(soil, datasets = "sotwis_polygons", country = "TUN",
                   with_geometry = "text")
g$components[[1]]
} # }
